title: Malicious Claude Code Extension Found on Cursor Marketplace
excerpt: A fake Anthropic Claude Code extension on the Cursor marketplace exposed developers to malware and SSH backdoors.
body_html:
A rogue version of Anthropic's Claude Code extension made its way onto the Cursor extension marketplace. The malicious software remained accessible for about 11 hours on October 29.

Reports indicate that the supply chain incident potentially affected up to 5,000 developers. The unauthorized package was crafted to deliver malware capable of setting up persistent SSH backdoors on compromised systems.
